name: I Want To Mend You Say Lord
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the Lord draws near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering healing and restoration to their wounded souls. God does not despise a broken and humble heart but instead forgives all iniquities and heals all diseases, binding up griefs and wounds. Christ’s suffering was the means by which peace and healing were secured, as His stripes bring spiritual restoration. Empowered by the Spirit, the Lord sends His messengers to proclaim liberty and to bind up the brokenhearted, demonstrating His desire to mend and renew those who turn to Him in faith.
